name: When should I consider replacing my home's flooring?

mainEntity.name: When should I consider replacing my home's flooring?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should consider replacing your flooring when it shows significant wear and tear, such as deep scratches, fading, buckling, or persistent stains. Outdated styles can also be a reason for replacement, especially if you're renovating or selling your home. Beyond aesthetics, replacement is often necessary if there's structural damage, water damage, or if allergens trapped in old carpets are affecting indoor air quality.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider replacing flooring due to significant wear, damage, outdated style, or if it negatively impacts indoor air quality.
